claims.claim: Every A9 packing can be normalized into an 1188×839 subrectangle of A0.
claims.evidence: For fixed labels and orientations, the feasible coordinate set is compact. At a minimizer of the sum of all x- and y-coordinates, any rectangle not on the left or top boundary must have a corresponding blocker; otherwise a sufficiently small translation would decrease the objective. Blocker chains strictly decrease the relevant coordinate and terminate at the boundary, making every right and bottom edge a nonnegative sum of 52 and 37. Exact enumeration shows that the largest such sums not exceeding 1189 and 841 are respectively 1188 and 839; 1189, 840, and 841 are not representable.
claims.search_method: Compactness and blocker-chain proof, followed by exhaustive integer enumeration of all nonnegative 52/37 representations up to the container dimensions.

claims.claim: There is an explicit packing of 516 sheets.
claims.evidence: Regenerating the three coordinate families gives exactly 60, 8, and 448 rectangles. Every rectangle has dimensions 52×37 or 37×52, lies within 1188×839, and every one of the 132870 unordered rectangle pairs is interior-disjoint.
claims.search_method: Regenerated all formula-defined rectangles with integers and exhaustively checked cardinality, orientation, containment, total area, and pairwise interior intersection.

claims.claim: No packing has 518 sheets; hence OPT≤517.
claims.evidence: After normalization, coordinates are integral. For every one of the 52² lower-left residue classes, a 52×37 or 37×52 rectangle contains exactly 37 cells satisfying x+y≡50 mod 52, hence has weight one. Direct exact counting gives 19162 marked cells in 1188×839, so the container weight is 19162/37=517+33/37<518. Disjointness therefore forces the integral packing size to be at most 517.
claims.witness: Assign weight 1/37 to each unit cell whose lower-left coordinates satisfy x+y≡50 (mod 52), and zero otherwise; the resulting exact certificate has total weight 19162/37.
claims.search_method: Exhaustively checked both orientations at all 2704 lower-left residue pairs and directly counted all marked cells in the reduced container using integer arithmetic.

claims.claim: Any hypothetical 517-packing must span a maximum reduced dimension and contain a prescribed blocking chain.
claims.evidence: For the simultaneous left/top-stable representative supplied by normalization, 517 sheets have area 994708, while 1187×838 has area 994706. Thus its maximum right edge is 1188 or its maximum bottom edge is 839. Following blockers from a rectangle attaining that edge yields a chain whose dimensions sum to the extremal value. Exact Diophantine enumeration gives the unique representations 1188=20·52+4·37 and 839=14·52+3·37. This is only a necessary condition on a normalized representative and does not exclude 517.
claims.search_method: Checked the bounding-area implication analytically and exhaustively enumerated every nonnegative 52/37 representation of both extremal dimensions.

claims.claim: The natural horizontal 111+728 decomposition is exactly capped at 516.
claims.evidence: The 1188×111 band has area capacity 68, attained by the first two placement grids. Exhaustion of all 156 feasible vertical cross-section count pairs verifies 5p+7q≤98, and exhaustion of all 396 horizontal pairs verifies 7p+5q≤160. Integrating gives 259N+n≤116424 and 260N−n≤116480, hence 519N≤232904<519·449 and N≤448 for the 1188×728 band. A 32×14 grid attains 448, so the fixed, noncrossing split has exact capacity 68+448=516.
claims.witness: Use the 68-sheet top-band construction from claim 1 and a 32×14 grid of 37×52 rectangles in the 1188×728 lower band.
claims.search_method: Exhaustively enumerated every nonnegative cross-section pair, checked both linear inequalities, recomputed the integrated bounds, and verified the attaining grids with integer arithmetic.

target_evidence: The exact target asks for a determination among 516, 517, and 518. The draft rigorously supplies a 516-placement and an upper-bound certificate excluding 518, establishing 516≤OPT≤517. Its blocker-chain and fixed-split results do not exclude general 517-packings, and it supplies no 517-placement. Thus it makes material but incomplete progress. The final writeup explicitly identifies the unresolved 516-versus-517 alternative, so its PARTIAL claimed_resolution is accurate and not overstated.
